T: What goes around comes around. So does dessert.
D: A smooth ad executive meets his match when his new boss treats him the way he treats women.
P: Serve the mains when Marcus and his friends sit down to Thanksgiving dinner.
S: Baked pork and beef meatballs in a sweet chili and grape jelly glaze

Little pork and beef meatballs baked until browned, then rolled in a sticky sweet chilli and grape jelly glaze and served on toothpicks. Mix 500g pork and beef mince with 1 egg, 40g breadcrumbs, a grated garlic clove and salt. Roll into 30 small balls and bake on a lined tray at 200C for 15 minutes until browned. Simmer 250ml sweet chilli sauce with 150g grape jelly in a wide pan for 5 minutes until glossy. Add the meatballs and turn until coated. Serve hot on toothpicks.
Smoked salmon and dill cream cheese rolled in tortillas and sliced
Soft tortillas spread with dill cream cheese, rolled with smoked salmon and cut into neat pinwheels.

Corn chips piled with beef and bean chilli and a hot cheddar cheese sauce, finished with pickled jalapeños, salsa and sour cream. Brown 300g beef mince with a diced onion and 2 tsp chilli powder, add a drained can of kidney beans and 100ml passata and simmer 15 minutes. Melt 20g butter, stir in 1 tbsp flour, whisk in 250ml milk and simmer until thick, then stir in 150g grated cheddar. Spread 300g corn chips on a platter, spoon over the chilli and cheese sauce, and top with jalapenos, salsa and sour cream.
M: the friends' Thanksgiving at Marcus's place

Brined turkey breast roasted juicy, sliced with cornbread and sage stuffing, maple candied sweet potato, cranberry sauce and a rich pan gravy. Brine a 1.5kg turkey breast overnight in 2L water with 100g salt and 50g sugar. Pat dry, rub with butter and roast at 170C to 70C inside, about 75 minutes, then rest. Toss 300g cubed cornbread with a fried onion, celery, sage and 250ml stock and bake 30 minutes. Roast 800g sweet potato chunks with butter and 3 tbsp maple syrup. Make gravy from the pan juices with flour and stock. Serve with cranberry sauce.
Seared eye fillet, creamy potato gratin and red wine pan sauce
Eye fillet seasoned and seared hard in butter, roasted at 200C to 54C, rested, the pan deglazed with red wine and stock for a glossy sauce, with a potato gratin and charred asparagus.
W: Spiced mashed sweet potato custard in a sweet pastry crust
Roasted sweet potato mashed with butter, brown sugar, eggs, evaporated milk, nutmeg and vanilla, baked in a blind-baked case at 170C for 50 minutes, whipped cream on top.
K: Gin, lemon and sugar syrup topped with sparkling wine in a flute
Gin, lemon and sugar topped with cold sparkling wine in a flute, with a lemon twist.

s.note: Baked pork and beef meatballs in a sweet chili and grape jelly glaze
s.how: Mix 500g pork and beef mince with 1 egg, 40g breadcrumbs, a grated garlic clove and salt. Roll into 30 small balls and bake on a lined tray at 200C for 15 minutes until browned. Simmer 250ml sweet chilli sauce with 150g grape jelly in a wide pan for 5 minutes until glossy. Add the meatballs and turn until coated. Serve hot on toothpicks.

s.note: Smoked salmon and dill cream cheese rolled in tortillas and sliced
s.how: Mix 250g cream cheese with chopped dill and lemon zest and spread over 4 large tortillas. Lay 200g smoked salmon over, roll up tightly, wrap and chill 1 hour, then slice into 2cm pinwheels.

m.note: Seared eye fillet, creamy potato gratin and red wine pan sauce
m.how: Layer thinly sliced potatoes with cream and bake at 180C for an hour. Sear 4 eye fillet steaks hard in butter, then roast at 200C to 54C and rest. Deglaze the pan with red wine and stock and reduce until glossy. Serve with charred asparagus.

w.note: Spiced mashed sweet potato custard in a sweet pastry crust
w.how: Roast 800g sweet potatoes until soft, then mash with 60g butter, 150g brown sugar, 2 eggs, 200ml evaporated milk, nutmeg and vanilla. Pour into a blind-baked sweet shortcrust case and bake at 170C for 50 minutes. Cool and top with whipped cream.

d.note: Gin, lemon and sugar syrup topped with sparkling wine in a flute
d.how: Shake 30ml gin, 15ml lemon juice and 10ml sugar syrup with ice and strain into 4 flutes. Top each with 90ml cold sparkling wine and add a lemon twist.
